//: The apps that have a landing page here. An entry is a repository and nothing else: the name, the copy, the screenshots and the privacy policy are read from it at build time by scripts/fetch-apps.mjs, so no word of an app's listing is written twice - once in its store metadata and once here. `ref` is the branch or tag holding marketing/listing.json and marketing/privacy.md - the paths come from the press kit, this is the ref they are read on, so a branch that has been merged and deleted cannot take the page down; `pressKit` is the branch its CI force-pushes the screenshots and their manifest to. Adding an app is adding an entry, provided it publishes that same trio.
